units.time: seconds of device uptime, the clock of ARFrame.timestamp and CMDeviceMotion.timestamp

conventions.world: ARKit world frame with worldAlignment .gravity: right-handed, y up (away from gravity), origin at the device's position when the session (epoch) started, -z the camera's initial facing projected onto the horizontal
conventions.camera: ARKit camera frame: +x right and +y up in the unrotated landscape sensor image, the camera looks along -z
conventions.pose: camera-to-world 4x4 matrix, 16 numbers column by column (simd_float4x4 layout), meters
conventions.intrinsics: [fx, fy, cx, cy] in pixels of the saved, unrotated landscape image
conventions.pixel: [u, v] continuous image coordinates: (0, 0) is the top-left corner of the top-left pixel, v grows down

source.sourceDataset: YouTube: 'My house in the spring of 2014 - outside walk around.'; https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0gotY_syWWU; YouTube standard licence (all rights reserved by uploader)
synthesizedFields: stills[].intrinsics (from the rounded 35 mm focal length)
source.notes: Pose-free control: the poses behind the other variants came from these same images.
